selected_config.rationale: physical=effective=16 is the semantics-preserving maximum (sequential optimizer + frozen effective batch 16); >16 changes the frozen effective batch or needs stale-adapter speculative forward; <16 needs grad_accum>1 which doubles TDX RPCs.

sweep_note: 8/16/32/64 measured as GPU-throughput characterization (effective=physical there). Only pb16 preserves the frozen effective batch. ex/s rises with batch because the fixed adamw_tdx (~113ms/opt-step, 168 factors) amortizes over more examples; ce network grows linearly with batch. peak mem 2.1/3.0/4.9/10.1 GB (A10 23 GB) — pb64 stable but invalid config.

remaining_bottleneck.dominant: fixed per-optimizer-step TDX round trips: adamw_tdx_compute ~113ms (168-factor un-fold/AdamW/re-fold on the CPU-only TDX guest) + ce/adamw network ~80ms, × 12630 steps.
remaining_bottleneck.inherent_vs_overhead: INHERENT to the protected design at effective batch 16 (one trusted AdamW round trip per optimizer step is required; the enclave holds m/v). Not implementation overhead. Further safe wins if needed: keep L5 fully local/plaintext (removes L5's TDX RPCs, ~-5h); speed the enclave fold matmuls (adamw_tdx). Neither needed to pass the gate.
remaining_bottleneck.gpu_now_minor: after batching, GPU fwd+bwd is ~28% of the step; was 81%.
